panel_dps.quote: DPS does not include damage from extra effects like explosive or incendiary.
panel_dps.qualification: General comparison table statement; does not explicitly define flamethrower panel 150 derivation or observed collision rate.
panel_dps.engineering_judgment: Under idealized nominal continuous contact, nominal DPS divided by per-particle direct damage times Fire strength is an equivalent buildup-rate approximation only if the same collision delivers both and nominal DPS represents direct particle damage. It is not an observed particle rate or established ignition time; threshold, buildup decay and collision timing remain unknown. Do not apply target damage multipliers or armor to base DPS before estimating equivalent collisions.
